Before (control): no Command, 5 x 78 = 390. After: the same HoT inside the ground: 78 x (1 - 0.60) = 31.2 per tick, 31 as an integer heal, 5 x 31 = 155 more, cumulative 545 (judged to the rounding). The enemy_ground entry reads 801534 on the enemy player after the Command, not before. A 45-point tick (Rejuvenation 8070, diag2) read 17 for 45 x 0.4 = 18: the float product falls just below 18 and truncates, so a tick whose 40% is not an integer is used.

behaviours.name: Crypt Plague (a second application does not refresh)
behaviours.quote: Additional applications do not refresh duration.
behaviours.observe_source: Crypt Plague 570131 (DurationIndex 1, 10000 ms; tooltip: additional applications do not refresh duration), applied by the game path: with Crypt Plague 92121 learned in both phases a Lichfrost 501978 hit adds 2 stacks through Plague() (AscensionNecromancerEvents.cpp:106-107; a fresh aura, then SetStackAmount for later ones, AscensionNecromancer.cpp:276-291). After: a first Lichfrost, 4000 ms, a second Lichfrost (a second application), and 10000 ms after the second cast starts (14000 ms after the first) the aura is gone; a refresh would hold it until about 16600 ms. 13000 ms between the phases let the control's aura expire. A direct 570131 cast (pair4 diagnostic) re-applies the aura through the stock path and refreshes it, so it is not the claim's path. Game time (ADR 0501, integration of batch M): the gone reading is judged at its game time after the second Lichfrost cast starts, inside 9100..12000 ms: after the first application's expiry (cast 4000 ms earlier, 2500 ms cast time, $d = 10000 ms: about 8500-8600 ms, plus the 500 ms G-19 band) and before a refreshed aura could end (2500 ms cast time + 10000 ms, less the band).

behaviours.name: Soulfreeze (Runic Power per tick, pooled roll)
behaviours.quote: Each tick generates 3 to 8 Runic Power.
behaviours.observe_source: Controller cycle 2 (398.0): pooled proof of the internal roll. Soulfreeze 801724 (aura 23 every 1000 ms for 3000 ms) triggers 801728 each tick, whose Effect[2] SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL casts 800344; 800344 Effect[1] SPELL_EFFECT_ENERGIZE MiscValue 6 (Runic Power), BasePoints 29 + DieSides 51: 30 to 80 internal units per tick (3.0 to 8.0 shown; the token $/10;800344s2 reads its base, 3). 160 real casts of 801724 at the dummy (140 gave 354 and 372 single events in pair p8: some ticks share an interval or fall outside it) (Ice Lock 22856 on it, the stable frozen fixture, and The End Is Near 680486 on the caster for the mana cost; 572023 not learned, so ticks do not re-proc), Runic Power set to 0 before each cast; the cumulative 800344 energize total and count are read every 250 ms, so an interval with exactly one event gives one tick's amount. Every amount must lie in 30..80 and both 30 and 80 must be seen in at least 384 single events: a uniform roll of 51 values misses one end with probability below 2 x (50/51)^384 = 1.0e-3 (controller sizing). Control: the start read, 0 events before the first cast.

behaviours.name: Icebound Champion (pushback reduction, game time)
behaviours.quote: and reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting by $807812s1%
behaviours.observe_source: Mentor-approved design 1 (2026-11-13, controller relay): Icebound Champion 807813's 807812 Effect[0] aura 149 SPELL_AURA_REDUCE_PUSHBACK BasePoints 49 + 1 = 50 ($807812s1); stock pushback (Spell::Delayed, Spell.cpp:8074-8090) delays the cast per damaging hit, less the REDUCE_PUSHBACK percent. ONE scenario, three Lichfrost 501978 casts (2500 ms) at the dummy: unhit; hit once by the passive striker's Light of the Naaru 41394 (Holy) 1000 ms into the cast; and the same after a real cast of Icebound Champion 807813. Every cast start, each strike (just before and just after the striker's cast step) and every poll of the caster's casting state (1 ms wait steps) is stamped with game_time_ms (ADR 0485), so each cast end is bracketed in game time between its last casting and first idle poll. Reduction = 1 - (reduced end - unhit end) / (hit end - unhit end), bracketed by the polls, judged in the G-19 band 47.5..52.5 around 50, no widening; the strike must land once per hit cast and at the same game-time offset into both casts within the poll bracket, else the reading is unmeasured (invalid, not failed). The side c nominal-wait entries (unhit_held .. pushback_control_done) stay as context only. Round 2: each cast is repeated 4 times (the four casts with the Champion fit inside its 20 s, the last ending about 18 s after the summon) (repeats, ADR 0546) with 41-poll windows starting 50-60 ms before the ends read in p1-p4 (2505, 3002, 2752), judged on the mean bracket middles with a 99% interval; a hit cast whose strike does not land on the caster (pair p5 run 1: the strike with the Champion up landed nowhere on the caster once, the cast ended unhit) is invalid and left out, and at least half of each kind must be valid.

behaviours.name: Lich Essence (pushback reduction, game time)
behaviours.quote: and reduces your spell pushback suffered from taking damage by $s1%.
behaviours.observe_source: Lich Essence 802988 (server DBC set): Effect[0] aura 149 SPELL_AURA_REDUCE_PUSHBACK BasePoints 49 + 1 = 50 ($s1), MiscValue 127 (every school); Effect[1] aura 108 SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME -15 on Lichfrost (the cast-time clause, proven by cast_by_2100 / cast_by_2150). Stock pushback (Spell::Delayed, Spell.cpp:8074-8090) delays a cast per damaging hit, less the REDUCE_PUSHBACK percent. The Icebound Champion game-time design (ADR 0543) with the reducer learned instead of cast, so four Lichfrost 501978 casts at the dummy in one scenario: unhit and hit once by the passive striker's Light of the Naaru 41394 1000 ms into the cast without the talent, then the talent learned (a real learn) and again unhit and hit. Every cast start, each strike and every casting poll is stamped with game_time_ms (ADR 0485). Because the talent also shortens Lichfrost by 15%, the pushback is taken within each talent state: reduction = 1 - (reduced hit end - reduced unhit end) / (hit end - unhit end), bracketed by the polls, judged in the G-19 band 47.5..52.5 around 50, no widening; the strikes must land once per hit cast and at the same game-time offset within the poll bracket, else the reading is unmeasured. Route of claim 240.0 (the earlier pushback_delays / pushback_halved windows rested on the engine's 500 ms base, which no tooltip states; the no-talent hit cast is now the observed control). Round 2 (controller rule: brackets crossing the band edge give no verdict): one poll step is one world tick, about 8-10 ms of game time (the 1 ms wait step), so a single cast end cannot be bracketed finer; each of the four casts is now repeated 10 times and the judge takes the mean bracket middle per kind with its 99% interval (pairs p2-p4 read single-cast brackets 44.95..52.08 with middles 48.1-49.1). Windows of 41 polls (about 370 ms of game time each; 21 polls missed one reduced end in pair p5 run 2) start about 50-60 ms before the ends pair p4 read (2509, 3004, 2129, 2381), so the 40 casts fit the 10000-step scenario limit.

behaviours.name: Underking (Animate pick at random)
behaviours.quote: is reduced by $/1000;302517s1 sec at random
behaviours.observe_source: necromancer_casts::OnSpellCast (AscensionNecromancerAbilities.cpp:301-314): with Underking 704701 each Command adds a 302516 stack; at 10 stacks it removes them, builds the pool of the known Animates among 805032 Bone Wraith, 805044 Tomb King and 805048 Plaguefather (HasSpell), cuts animates[urand(0, n - 1)] through Reduce by |Amount(302517)| = 15000 ms (302517 Effect[0] BasePoints -15001, $/1000;302517s1 = 15) and summons 525380 (creature 503032). Reduce calls ModifySpellCooldown, a no-op without a cooldown entry (Player.cpp:11950-11954), so each cycle primes all three with a real cast after reset_cooldown (RecoveryTime 60000 / 60000 / 120000 ms; mana set to the fixture maximum 2848 before each, the max_mana entry of 707588; ManaCostPercentage 28 / 28 / 25). Ten Command: Undead 504868 at the dummy 1600 ms apart; cooldown_ms (end - now) of the three read before and 300 ms after the tenth: the two Animates not picked drop by the elapsed time only (the median drop), the picked one by 15000 more (+- 100 ms). Control: one cycle per part before 704701 is learned: no cut, no Greater Zombie. Three parts of 10 cycles, pooled (30 cycles): every cycle cuts exactly one cooldown; 'at random' over a uniform pool of three: every Animate picked at least once (P(fail) <= 3 x (2/3)^30 = 1.6e-5) and each count inside the two-sided 99.9% binomial band 2..19 of 30. 172.0 (only 805044 known) remains the single-pool control. Design: review/c7-91-172-designs.md section 172.1.

behaviours.name: Raise: Banshee (Command drain)
behaviours.quote: and deals Frost damage equal to the mana drained
behaviours.observe_source: An enemy player (a Necromancer, race 2, 2803 maximum mana, full) is the target: the dummy has no mana. Both phases cast Command: Undead 504868 at it; the treatment raises a Banshee 500650 first. npc_ascension_necromancer::DoAction, case 500650: mana = min(target mana, min(target max / 10, the player's max / 5)) (owner ruling Q-a1-4 (b), Necromancer ADR 0017), ModifyPower(-mana), then Copy 505225 (Frost) for that amount. The tooltip's 10% of the target's mana is 280; neither cap binds here (20% of the player's 2848 is 569). Control: no Banshee, no hit.

behaviours.name: Raise: Banshee (Command drain capped by the player's mana)
behaviours.quote: up to a maximum of
behaviours.observe_source: Cap-binding arm (owner ruling Q-a1-4 (b): the player's maximum mana caps the drain, Necromancer ADR 0017). Target: the dummy fixture as Magus Zabraxis 16829 (creature_template level 60, unit_class 2, ManaModifier 3, no script; creature_classlevelstats level 60 class 2 basemana 2434: 7302 maximum mana, read by drain_cap_target). Precondition fixtures on the caster: 823764 keeps the Frost copy unresisted; Mental Acuity 4270 (Effect[0] aura 35, +330 mana, permanent) raises the player's maximum mana to 2848 + 330 = 3178 (read by drain_cap_player) and leaves the Banshee's (level x 30 + Intellect x 5 x 2 Life Force, Scale() in AscensionNecromancerSummons.cpp: 2970 read in pilot probe3) unchanged. Expected: 10% of the target is 730, 20% of the player's maximum mana is 635, so the player cap binds: 635. The other readings give 730 (the target's cap, 15% above) and 594 (the Banshee's cap, the code before Necromancer ADR 0017, 6.5% below), both outside the G-19 band of 635. Control: no Banshee, no hit.

Cycle 2 F2: the client text now states 70% (owner text item 8, rev_20261113_32_necromancer_owner_text_items.sql), so the tooltip model already carries the Ghoul's -30% healing done (805290 Effect[1]); 805290 is no longer added as a model aura.

behaviours.quote: health to you.

Cycle 2 F2: the client text now states 70% (owner text item 8, rev_20261113_32_necromancer_owner_text_items.sql), so the tooltip model already carries the Ghoul's -30% healing done (805290 Effect[1]); 805290 is no longer added as a model aura.

behaviours.name: Command: Bonefreeze (one freeze cast per Command)
behaviours.quote: (8 sec vs players).
behaviours.observe_source: Order() sends the Command to the caster's selection (the dummy, select_dummy, 3 yd out) when the spell has no enemy unit target (AscensionNecromancerSummons.cpp:453-460); a Skeletal Mage answers by casting Bonefreeze 504845 once at that target (:667-668, Necromancer ADR 0050), and its own 8 yd area (TARGET_UNIT_DEST_AREA_ENEMY 16, EffectRadiusIndex 14) selects the enemies; DurationIndex 64 is 40000 ms on creatures (the area_held / area_ends entries). An enemy player (race 2, PvP on both sides, the layout of the Command: Blight enemy entries) stands at the scenario's start point, within 8 yd of the dummy. Control arm of the player_duration entry (Necromancer ADR 0050): with two enemies (the dummy and the player) inside the area the Mage casts 504845 once, so each enemy is hit once by the area. The enemy player counts the Mage's (creature 50075) SMSG_SPELL_GO packets of 504845 (spell_go_count). Before (control): a raised Mage, no Command: 0 casts. After: one real Command: 1 cast (the former loop cast once per enemy in range: 2).

behaviours.name: Command: Bonefreeze (damage ends it)
behaviours.quote: Damage taken may end the effect.
behaviours.observe_source: As the freeze entry (frozen 300 ms after the Command), read 6000 ms later: the Mage attacks the frozen dummy after the Command (AttackStart in DoAction; its Frost 801513 hits) and the contract adds AURA_INTERRUPT_FLAG_TAKE_DAMAGE to 504845 (AscensionNecromancerContracts.cpp:294), so the freeze is gone long before its 40000 ms. Read with the damage-count entry, which shows the Mage's hits land in that window.

behaviours.name: Command: Bonefreeze (Mage hits on the frozen dummy)
behaviours.quote: Damage taken may end the effect.
behaviours.observe_source: The same arms: the Mage's hits on the dummy in the caster's combat log, none before the Command (the Mage follows, no victim), at least one within 6000 ms after it: the damage that ends the freeze.

behaviours.name: Command: Bonefreeze (not in Pacify)

Both phases raise a Skeletal Mage and cast 504489; the control phase is not Pacified: no failure (0); the treatment has 500983 set on the caster by harness set_aura (precondition fixture; its own clause is proven in B2) and is refused with 173.

behaviours.name: Command: Bonefreeze (area)
behaviours.quote: Command your Skeletal Mages to freeze enemies at target location
behaviours.radius_reason: DoAction casts Bonefreeze 504845 once at the Command's target (AscensionNecromancerSummons.cpp:667-668, Necromancer ADR 0050); 504845 is an 8 yd area at its target (TARGET_UNIT_DEST_AREA_ENEMY, EffectRadiusIndex 14; the contract that would make it single-target is dead for family 21, observation O-b3b-1), and the three additional dummies stand 2, 4 and 6 yd from the primary, inside it
behaviours.observe_source: Undead: Pacify 500983 set on the caster right after the Command (post_cast_auras, ADR 0560; precondition fixture: the Mage stays passive and its damage is blocked, AscensionNecromancerEvents.cpp:350-355; the claim is the freeze, not the Mage's damage): without it the Skeletal Mage's first splash landed before the 500 ms read in 31 of 60 copies and broke every freeze (504845 ends on damage, F-b3b-1); with it 60 of 60 copies read all four dummies frozen and no Mage damage (diagnostics 20261113-115218 / -115902). One Skeletal Mage is raised, then Command: Bonefreeze at the selected primary dummy (select_primary, ADR 0423); 504845 (cast by the Mage, read on each dummy whatever its caster) on every additional dummy right after the Command, before the Mage's first 801513 splash. Control: before 504489 is learned the Command is refused, no freeze.

behaviours.name: Command: Bonefreeze (held without damage)
behaviours.quote: for $504845d (8 sec vs players).
behaviours.radius_reason: placement only: one additional dummy 7.5 yd from the primary (radius x 1/2), inside the 8 yd freeze around the target and outside the 6 yd of the Mage's 801513 splash ($801513a1), so no damage reaches it
behaviours.observe_source: As the area entry, read 38500 ms after the Command: the Mage's splash hits only within 6 yd of its target (diagnostic pair prove-10: the dummies 2 to 6 yd away took a hit and lost the freeze), so the dummy 7.5 yd away takes no damage and is still frozen, the no-damage control of Necromancer ADR 0011 and the creature duration's lower bound against 40000 ms.

The caster's melee crit chance against the dummy (Unit::GetUnitCriticalChance, the attacker crit modifiers of the target included) after one Lichfrost: one point higher with 531135's 706732 on the dummy (BasePoints 0 + 1 = 1, $706732s1) than without (expected_gain, ADR 0380). Near arm: caster 12 yd from the dummy, the Ghoul inside 20 yd: 801545 heals. Far arm (control): caster 28 yd away, the Ghoul more than 23 yd away (20 + a 3 yd object size margin): no heal. behaviours.name: March of the Dead (explosion damage with spell power)
behaviours.quote: Plague damage (Nature or Shadow spell power) to nearby enemies
behaviours.observe_source: Non-matching school arm (owner ruling Q-b3b-6 (b): the spell's own schools, mask 40, Necromancer ADR 0021): Increase Frost Dam 132 24666 (+132 Frost) set on the caster before its stats are measured. The walkers' 707010 (NecromancerCoefficients row {707010, 0, 0.75, 40}) reads Shadow and Nature spell power only, so the hit stays the spell power 0 value of the explosion entry; before Necromancer ADR 0021 it added 0.75 x 132 = 99.

behaviours.name: March of the Dead (explosion damage with spell power of every school)
behaviours.quote: Plague damage (Nature or Shadow spell power) to nearby enemies
behaviours.observe_source: Matching arm (owner ruling Q-b3b-6 (b), Necromancer ADR 0021): QA Test +100 SP 10062 (Effect[0] aura 345 MiscValue 127, every school, +100) set on the caster before its stats are measured. The walkers' 707010 (NecromancerCoefficients row {707010, 0, 0.75, 40}) adds 0.75 x 100 = 75 to each hit, the $SP*.75 term of the tooltip read with the measured stats ($SP is the lowest school spell power, so a one-school fixture cannot raise the expectation; a Shadow-only +78 33819 read 749 per hit in pair1, 691 + 0.75 x 78 = 749.5 truncated). Control: the same trials without the cast (control_casts empty) count no 707010 hit.

behaviours.name: March of the Dead (explosion damage with Shadow spell power)
behaviours.quote: Plague damage (Nature or Shadow spell power) to nearby enemies
behaviours.observe_source: Matching single-school arm (owner ruling Q-b3b-6 (b): the spell's own schools, mask 40 = Nature + Shadow, so Shadow spell power counts; mentor ruling 2026-11-13, Necromancer ADR 0021). Increase Shadow Dam 78 33819 (Effect[0] aura 13 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_DONE, MiscValue 32 Shadow, BasePoints 77 + 1 = 78, permanent) set on the caster before its stats are measured. Expected per hit: $707010m1 x $<scalingbp> + 0.75 x 78 = 691.2 + 58.5 = 749.7, the engine's integer 749. The tool reads the tooltip's $SP as the lowest school spell power (0 here), so its model gives the spell power 0 value 691 (the explosion entry); multiplier = 749 / 691 = 1.0839363241678726 carries the 0.75 x 78 Shadow term onto that model. The tooltip's displayed $SP (lowest school) and the server (mask 40) disagree for a one-school fixture: a text observation, no server change. Control: the same trials without the cast (control_casts empty) count no 707010 hit.

behaviours.quote: and deals Weapon Damage plus ${$570042m2+($SP*.35)*0.39}
behaviours.observe_source: Fix FN-c1t-1 (b) regression (contract: 570042 Effect[2] SPELL_EFFECT_WEAPON_PERCENT_DAMAGE BasePoints 199 = 200%, AscensionNecromancerContracts.cpp; controller cycle 2: damage == 2.0 x the swing read + the Effect[1] flat part, 5% band; the earlier 2.1 total ratio is superseded). Arithmetic: 570042 Effect[1] SCHOOL_DAMAGE BasePoints 0 + DieSides 1 = 1, plus $SP*.35*.39 = 0.1365 x SP through the coefficient row {570042, 1, 0.1365} (AscensionNecromancerData.h:52); the reference caster's spell power is 0 (class file reference_stats), so the flat part is 1 per hit; the weapon part, Effect[2] SPELL_EFFECT_NORMALIZED_WEAPON_DMG, is the Warrior's own swing range for a creature (Unit::GetAPMultiplier, Unit.cpp:15067-15068). The judge takes 1 off every strike hit and divides by the per-swing mean: expected 2.0, band 1.90..2.10. Control: the same Warrior's plain swings (no crit, no glancing) in the same Commands. Mentor ruling Q-b2b-4 (2026-11-13 09:08, owner answer (a) fund the read): the Warrior's Command hit 570042 (Effect[1] SCHOOL_DAMAGE BasePoints 0 DieSides 1, Effect[2] SPELL_EFFECT_NORMALIZED_WEAPON_DMG, DmgClass melee, Physical, EffectDamageMultiplier 1.0) is judged as the non-crit hit over the same Greater Skeletal Warrior 51065's non-crit swing at level 60, expected 2.1 in the G-19 band of 5% of that ratio (1.995 to 2.205); the live band 2.0-2.2 comes from 168 log groups (review/q-b2b-4-weapon-research.md: Command/swing median 2.12, p10 2.00, p90 2.33; 9 groups with owner swings 2.00-2.20; the Command follows the Warrior's swing, not the owner's). A real 504901 raises the Warrior at the caster; one Command: Skeletal Warriors 504905 at the dummy starts its attack (the Warrior turns and casts 570042, AscensionNecromancerSummons.cpp:678-682), then 90 more Commands 3000 ms apart, in 3 parts pooled by the judge; after each, the Warrior's non-critical unblocked 570042 hits on the dummy (caster_entry) and its plain melee swings (pet_melee_plain_*, no crit, no glancing) are read: the swing is the observed control. The first Command's hit and swings fall before the start reads, so both sides carry the same Pierced 570216 armor reduction. The Warrior's minimum weapon damage (owned_creature_weapon_damage_min) is recorded once, not judged.

behaviours.name: Raise: Greater Skeletal Warrior (Command over swing, 1000 spell power)
behaviours.quote: and deals Weapon Damage plus ${$570042m2+($SP*.35)*0.39}
behaviours.observe_source: The spell-power arm of weapon_ratio (controller condition for FN-c1t-1 (b)): Effect[1] is SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE (server DBC set), not a weapon-damage effect, so Spell::EffectWeaponDmg collects no flat weapon bonus from it (SpellEffects.cpp: only WEAPON_DAMAGE, WEAPON_DAMAGE_NOSCHOOL and NORMALIZED_WEAPON_DMG add to fixed_bonus) and the 200% leaves it single. With 1000 spell power on the caster (harness fixture) the flat part is 1 + 1000 x 0.35 x 0.39 = 137.5 per hit (coefficient row {570042, 1, 0.1365}, AscensionNecromancerData.h:52): the strike less 137.5 must be 2.0 x the swing (band 1.90..2.10); a doubled flat part would read about 2.0 + 137.5 / 197 = 2.70 (the swing with 1000 spell power reads about 197). 90 Commands in 2 parts pooled by the judge. Observation (pair 20261113-110216 / -110253): 1.953 / 1.951, about 2.4% under 2.0 (99% interval about 1.91..1.99, excluding 2.0, inside the band); likely cause, NOT measured: the judge takes off the unmitigated 137.5 from an armor-reduced Physical hit. No judge change. Live (review/q-b2b-4-weapon-research.md): Command = 21.2 + 2.034 x swing over 168 groups, a flat term not doubled.

Read: owned_creature_school_spell_crit_chance (STATE, Unit::SpellDoneCritChance with no victim, the probe Lichfrost 501978, MAGIC, SchoolMask 16, school_mask 16: m_baseSpellCritChance + GetTotalAuraModifierByMiscMask(71, Frost) + the owner's crit spell mods, Unit.cpp:10264-10311); the owner's spell mods are the same in both phases, so the gain is judged. behaviours.name: Entomb (immune to Physical damage, enemy player)
behaviours.quote: and making them immune to Physical damage
behaviours.observe_source: Owner ruling Q-c7-1 (2026-11-13): keep #6786 (212d773dde), partial school immunity is dropped on NPCs by design, so the claim is measured on an enemy player. Entomb 500341 (server DBC set): Effect[2] aura 40 SPELL_AURA_DAMAGE_IMMUNITY, EffectMiscValue[2] 1 (Physical), on the target, DurationIndex 35 (4000 ms); AuraEffect::HandleAuraModDmgImmunity (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:4249-4256) applies IMMUNITY_DAMAGE with that mask only (SpellInfo.cpp:2795-2798, 2885-2886); Spell.cpp:2885-2891 sends no damage log for an immune hit. An enemy player (race 2, class 8 Mage, enemy_player_class ADR 0561, PvP on both sides) is the target; the caster casts Void Zone 92559 (SchoolMask 1 Physical, SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE 1000, instant, an enemy target; the Physical strike of the Phylactery physical entry) at it. spell_damage_count is cumulative over the scenario (no reset between the phases; the dummy layout read 1 before and 2 after, c6). Before (control): no Entomb, the Physical hit lands on the player (1 damage log). After: a real Entomb at the player, then the same Physical cast 500 ms later (neither spell has a global cooldown, StartRecoveryTime 0): no new damage log, still 1 in all; a target that is not immune reads 2. Incorrect test corrected: the former expected 0 ignored the control's log. The caster holds its spell hit rating fixture (player fixture) in both phases.

behaviours.name: Plague Protection 570046 (Fetid Ward healing received)
behaviours.quote: Increases the effectiveness of your Wards by $s1%.
behaviours.expected_source: Judged in the G-19 band (cycle 3, mentor): the ratio is read as the Fetid Ward aura amount, (ratio x 1.10 - 1) x 100, against the int32 amount 11 in 5% of it (10.45 to 11.55, ADR 0571), not by a 99% interval that must hold the exact 1.11 / 1.10. Observation, not traced: the ratio sits 0.03-0.09% under 1.11 / 1.10 in every run (pair M 1.0085 / 1.0087, c1 1.0082 / 1.0088, cycle 3 1.0087 / 1.0090), an amount of about 10.9 to 11.0. 570046 Effect[0] aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS (MiscValue 8) +15 ($s1, BasePoints 14 + 1) on EffectSpellClassMask word 2 0x80, which Fetid Ward 680388 carries (SpellFamilyFlags[2] 128) (server DBC set). Fetid Ward Effect[1] aura 118 SPELL_AURA_MOD_HEALING_PCT +10 ($s2) on its holder: 15% more effective is 11.5%, an int32 aura amount of 11 (SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue truncation, the integer-truncation ruling of 2026-11-11, as the Templar Radiant Blade entries), so the treatment over the control is 1.11 / 1.10 = 1.0091. Both arms learn and cast Fetid Ward before each heal; the treatment also learns the talent (a real learn). Flash Heal 10917 cast by the caster on itself (another heal source), spell power 20000 fixture, non-critical heals only; cast_power 1373 refills mana. Judged in the talent's own unit through the int32 amount (ADR 0239, ADR 0241): passes when a bonus inside the G-19 band gives that amount.
